bottleneck.description: Photoelectric, laser displacement and FA sensors plus security PIR sensors, competing with Keyence, Omron, SICK, Panasonic, Banner, Pepperl+Fuchs and Micro-Epsilon.

dependency.key_customers: Factory automation integrators, security/automatic door OEMs, electronics assembly customers in Japan/US/Europe/Asia
dependency.key_suppliers: Image sensor vendors, optical component suppliers, electronics CMs

editorial.notes: Optex operates in highly fragmented industrial sensor categories (photoelectric, laser displacement, fiber, machine-vision lighting, security PIR) where the market leaders are Keyence, Omron, SICK and Panasonic; Optex is a mid-tier specialist with strong niches but no structural choke-point. Customers routinely qualify multiple vendors per sensor class with low switching friction. Aligns with the LOW frontier-stack baseline for peer-competitive industrial sensor incumbents.
